name: ProgressDetails
intent: A period-based progress-details workspace for reviewing and drilling a WBS (work breakdown structure): a three-bar header (tab switcher + week/period selector; period status + approval counters + Import / Close-Period actions; search + sort + filter), a searchable WBS Navigator sidebar (CanvasNavigator), and a content list that drills the full hierarchy — zone → category → division → task → object. Every row is the shared ProgressListItem (generic / task / object variants); clicking an object opens the Operations Drawer to review and edit its operations' progress. The breadcrumb collapses responsively and each level's rows show earned-value metrics + a progress bar.
when: Review a collection period's earned-value progress across a WBS and drill zone → task → object
Edit per-operation progress for an object from a right-side Operations Drawer
Browse a hierarchy in a sidebar navigator synced to a breadcrumb-driven content list
whenNot: Inspect one floor's blueprint plan (pan/zoom) -> use the BlueprintViewer template
A geospatial map of sites / an org KPI overview -> use the Dashboard template
A single work-item card outside a list -> use the WorkItemCard widget

chooseOver.over: Assembling CanvasNavigator + Breadcrumb + a list of ProgressListItem + OperationsDrawer by hand
chooseOver.because: The ProgressDetails template owns the three-bar header, the sidebar↔breadcrumb↔list navigation state, the responsive breadcrumb collapse, and the object→Operations-Drawer flow.

regions.role: Top bar: Collection/Comparison view switcher (left) + the date-range + period pager (right)
Period bar: period code + Open status badge + cut-off + centered Approved/Pending/Rejected counters, with Export / Recent-imports / Import / Close-Period actions on the right
regions.source: Badge + Button + ButtonGroup + local status dots

regions.role: WBS Navigator sidebar (searchable) — drills zones → categories → divisions; its collapse control hides the whole sidebar
Condensed content header: back button + responsive ellipsis breadcrumb (left) and search + Sort + filter (right)
The current node's children as divided rows in a white card; rows drill in, objects open the drawer
Right-side overlay drawer editing the selected object's operations (progress table)
